caption: The drawing features a detailed, grayscale illustration of a lidded tankard at the center, decorated with intricate floral motifs and an emblem containing a stag, along with a ribbon displaying the Latin phrase "VIRTUS IN ACTIONE CONSISTIT." The tankard has a domed lid with a scroll-shaped thumb piece and a pronounced, flared base. Surrounding the central image are four distinct sections: the top left contains a circular monogram with interwoven letters surrounded by leafy foliage; the bottom left displays a simple side view outline of the tankard, showing its handle and the hinged lid; the right side contains two elements, with the upper portion showing the ornamental thumb piece design, and the lower portion depicting a vertical, tapered piece, likely a foot or element of the tankard's structure, ending in decorative details. The overall composition is rendered in light brown and grey tones, combining both shaded and line-drawn elements on a cream-colored background.
title: Silver Tankard
